title: Replace Inline Code with Function Call
refactorings: Replace Inline Code with Function Call

solutions.title: One predicate, called from both features
solutions.tradeoff: order-safety.ts now depends on menu.ts's notion of what makes a product safe, so a future change to that definition - say, the online menu starts ignoring trace-allergen labels a sensitive customer still cares about - silently changes what production flags too, instead of the two checks drifting independently and announcing the disagreement.

reviewFocus: Did you establish that the hand-rolled loop and productIsSafeFor agree on every avoided allergen, or only that the given tests pass? Those are not the same claim.
Does itemsWithAllergenConflict still contain any hand-written loop over allergens, or does order-safety.ts now import and call productIsSafeFor?
If a product lists the same allergen twice, or the order's avoid-list repeats one, does the flagged list still include the item exactly once?
Does index.ts still export itemsWithAllergenConflict under the same name and signature, with nothing in tests/ touched?

menu.ts and order-safety.ts now both depend on productIsSafeFor's definition of "safe" - is that coupling the right call here, or would a reviewer reasonably want the production safety check to stay independent of the browsing feature, even at the cost of the duplication?
